description.p: Tavletta designs labels with text, images, symbols and codes, shows them exactly as they will be printed and prints them over the network or USB: on label printers with endless tape or die-cut labels, and on office printers, one label per page or on label sheets. It talks to each printer in its own language.

يصمّم Tavletta ملصقات بالنصوص والصور والرموز والأكواد، ويعرضها تمامًا كما ستُطبع، ويطبعها عبر الشبكة أو USB: على طابعات الملصقات ذات الشريط المتصل أو الملصقات المقطوعة مسبقًا، وعلى طابعات المكاتب، ملصقًا واحدًا في كل صفحة أو على أوراق ملصقات. ويتحدث مع كل طابعة بلغتها الخاصة.

Tavletta gestaltet Etiketten mit Text, Bildern, Symbolen und Codes, zeigt sie genau so, wie sie gedruckt werden, und druckt sie über das Netzwerk oder USB: auf Etikettendruckern mit Endlosband oder gestanzten Etiketten sowie auf Bürodruckern, ein Etikett pro Seite oder auf Etikettenbögen. Es spricht mit jedem Drucker in dessen eigener Sprache.

Tavletta diseña etiquetas con texto, imágenes, símbolos y códigos, las muestra exactamente como se imprimirán y las imprime por red o USB: en impresoras de etiquetas con cinta continua o etiquetas troqueladas, y en impresoras de oficina, una etiqueta por página o en hojas de etiquetas. Habla con cada impresora en su propio idioma.

Tavletta kujundab silte tekstide, piltide, sümbolite ja koodidega, näitab neid täpselt sellisena, nagu need prinditakse, ning prindib võrgu või USB kaudu: pideva lindiga või väljalõigatud siltidega sildiprinteritel ning kontoriprinteritel, üks silt lehe kohta või sildilehtedel. See räägib iga printeriga selle enda keeles.

Tavletta suunnittelee tarroja tekstillä, kuvilla, symboleilla ja koodeilla, näyttää ne täsmälleen sellaisina kuin ne tulostetaan ja tulostaa ne verkon tai USB:n kautta: tarratulostimilla, joissa on jatkuva nauha tai stanssatut tarrat, sekä toimistotulostimilla, yksi tarra sivulle tai tarra-arkeille. Se puhuu jokaisen tulostimen omaa kieltä.

Tavletta crée des étiquettes avec du texte, des images, des symboles et des codes, les affiche exactement comme elles seront imprimées et les imprime par le réseau ou en USB : sur des imprimantes d’étiquettes à ruban continu ou à étiquettes prédécoupées, et sur des imprimantes de bureau, une étiquette par page ou sur des planches d’étiquettes. Elle parle à chaque imprimante dans son propre langage.

Tavletta टेक्स्ट, चित्रों, प्रतीकों और कोड वाले लेबल डिज़ाइन करता है, उन्हें ठीक वैसे ही दिखाता है जैसे वे छपेंगे, और नेटवर्क या USB से प्रिंट करता है: निरंतर टेप या पहले से कटे लेबल वाले लेबल प्रिंटरों पर, और ऑफ़िस प्रिंटरों पर, प्रति पेज एक लेबल या लेबल शीट पर। यह हर प्रिंटर से उसकी अपनी भाषा में बात करता है।

A Tavletta szöveggel, képekkel, szimbólumokkal és kódokkal tervez címkéket, pontosan úgy mutatja őket, ahogy nyomtatva lesznek, és hálózaton vagy USB-n keresztül kinyomtatja őket: folyamatos szalagos vagy stancolt címkés címkenyomtatókon, valamint irodai nyomtatókon, oldalanként egy címkével vagy címkeíveken. Minden nyomtatóval a saját nyelvén beszél.

Tavletta merancang label dengan teks, gambar, simbol, dan kode, menampilkannya persis seperti yang akan dicetak, lalu mencetaknya lewat jaringan atau USB: pada printer label dengan pita kontinu atau label potong, dan pada printer kantor, satu label per halaman atau pada lembar label. Aplikasi ini berbicara dengan setiap printer dalam bahasanya sendiri.

Tavletta crea etichette con testo, immagini, simboli e codici, le mostra esattamente come verranno stampate e le stampa via rete o USB: su stampanti di etichette con nastro continuo o etichette fustellate, e su stampanti da ufficio, un’etichetta per pagina o su fogli di etichette. Parla con ogni stampante nel suo linguaggio.
Tavlettaは、文字、画像、シンボル、コードを使ってラベルをデザインし、印刷されるとおりの状態で表示して、ネットワークまたはUSB経由で印刷します。連続テープやダイカットラベルを使うラベルプリンターのほか、1ページに1枚、またはラベルシートに印刷するオフィス用プリンターにも対応します。プリンターごとに、そのプリンター固有の言語で通信します。
Tavletta는 텍스트, 이미지, 기호, 코드가 들어간 라벨을 디자인하고, 인쇄될 모습 그대로 보여 주며, 네트워크나 USB로 인쇄합니다. 연속 테이프나 다이컷 라벨을 쓰는 라벨 프린터는 물론, 페이지당 라벨 한 장 또는 라벨 시트로 인쇄하는 사무용 프린터도 지원합니다. 각 프린터와 그 프린터 고유의 언어로 통신합니다.

Tavletta mereka bentuk label dengan teks, imej, simbol dan kod, memaparkannya tepat seperti yang akan dicetak dan mencetaknya melalui rangkaian atau USB: pada pencetak label dengan pita berterusan atau label pra-potong, dan pada pencetak pejabat, satu label setiap halaman atau pada helaian label. Ia berkomunikasi dengan setiap pencetak dalam bahasanya sendiri.

Tavletta ontwerpt etiketten met tekst, afbeeldingen, symbolen en codes, toont ze precies zoals ze worden afgedrukt en drukt ze af via het netwerk of USB: op etiketprinters met doorlopende tape of gestanste etiketten, en op kantoorprinters, één etiket per pagina of op etikettenvellen. Het spreekt met elke printer in zijn eigen taal.

Tavletta projektuje etykiety z tekstem, obrazami, symbolami i kodami, pokazuje je dokładnie tak, jak zostaną wydrukowane, i drukuje przez sieć lub USB: na drukarkach etykiet z taśmą ciągłą lub etykietami wykrojonymi oraz na drukarkach biurowych, po jednej etykiecie na stronę lub na arkuszach etykiet. Komunikuje się z każdą drukarką w jej własnym języku.

O Tavletta cria etiquetas com texto, imagens, símbolos e códigos, mostra-as exatamente como serão impressas e imprime-as pela rede ou por USB: em impressoras de etiquetas com fita contínua ou etiquetas pré-cortadas e em impressoras de escritório, uma etiqueta por página ou em folhas de etiquetas. Fala com cada impressora na sua própria linguagem.

O Tavletta cria etiquetas com texto, imagens, símbolos e códigos, mostra exatamente como serão impressas e imprime pela rede ou por USB: em impressoras de etiquetas com fita contínua ou etiquetas pré-cortadas e em impressoras de escritório, uma etiqueta por página ou em folhas de etiquetas. Ele fala com cada impressora na própria linguagem dela.

Tavletta создаёт этикетки с текстом, изображениями, символами и кодами, показывает их точно в том виде, в каком они будут напечатаны, и печатает по сети или через USB: на принтерах этикеток с непрерывной лентой или высечными этикетками, а также на офисных принтерах, по одной этикетке на страницу или на листах этикеток. Программа общается с каждым принтером на его собственном языке.

Tavletta utformar etiketter med text, bilder, symboler och koder, visar dem exakt som de skrivs ut och skriver ut via nätverket eller USB: på etikettskrivare med löpande tejp eller stansade etiketter, och på kontorsskrivare, en etikett per sida eller på etikettark. Programmet talar med varje skrivare på dess eget språk.

Tavletta ออกแบบฉลากด้วยข้อความ รูปภาพ สัญลักษณ์ และโค้ด แสดงให้เห็นตรงตามที่จะพิมพ์ออกมา และพิมพ์ผ่านเครือข่ายหรือ USB: บนเครื่องพิมพ์ฉลากที่ใช้เทปต่อเนื่องหรือฉลากไดคัต และบนเครื่องพิมพ์สำนักงาน ครั้งละหนึ่งฉลากต่อหน้า หรือบนแผ่นฉลาก โดยสื่อสารกับเครื่องพิมพ์แต่ละเครื่องด้วยภาษาของมันเอง

Tavletta, metin, görsel, simge ve kodlarla etiketler tasarlar, bunları tam yazdırılacakları şekilde gösterir ve ağ üzerinden ya da USB ile yazdırır: sürekli şerit veya kalıp kesim etiketli etiket yazıcılarında ve ofis yazıcılarında, sayfa başına bir etiket olarak ya da etiket sayfalarına. Her yazıcıyla kendi dilinde konuşur.

Tavletta створює етикетки з текстом, зображеннями, символами та кодами, показує їх точно такими, якими вони будуть надруковані, і друкує через мережу або USB: на принтерах етикеток із безперервною стрічкою чи висічними етикетками, а також на офісних принтерах, по одній етикетці на сторінку або на аркушах етикеток. Програма спілкується з кожним принтером його власною мовою.

Tavletta thiết kế nhãn với văn bản, hình ảnh, biểu tượng và mã, hiển thị đúng như khi in và in qua mạng hoặc USB: trên máy in nhãn dùng băng liên tục hoặc nhãn cắt sẵn, và trên máy in văn phòng, mỗi trang một nhãn hoặc trên tờ nhãn. Ứng dụng giao tiếp với từng máy in bằng ngôn ngữ riêng của nó.
Tavletta 可用文字、图片、符号和代码设计标签，按实际打印效果显示，并通过网络或 USB 打印：支持使用连续标签带或模切标签的标签打印机，也支持办公打印机，每页一张标签或打印到标签纸上。它会用每台打印机各自的语言与其通信。
Tavletta 可用文字、圖片、符號和代碼設計標籤，依實際列印效果顯示，並透過網路或 USB 列印：支援使用連續標籤帶或模切標籤的標籤印表機，也支援辦公室印表機，每頁一張標籤或列印到標籤紙上。它會用每台印表機各自的語言與其通訊。

description.p: Linux packages (.deb, .rpm) for 1.2; test fixes.
A web page for the print server, signing in with OpenID Connect, and editing with the mouse.

ul.li: Print server: a web page to print single labels, series from a data file and ranges of numbers, with a preview, and for administrators to upload templates
Print server: people sign in to the web page with OpenID Connect (Keycloak, Authentik, Entra ID and others), their roles and printers from the provider
Labels are edited with the mouse or by touch on the preview: move, resize, align
Printers found on USB and in the network come first in the model list
"Use loaded labels" adapts a label to the labels the printer has loaded
cab: a print offset per printer, and the labels of a series printed as one job of up to "Labels per job" labels, without stopping between them
Label sheets: a job of more than 999 labels is refused before the first sheet instead of being cut short
Rows given as two numbers without a dash ("3 4") are refused instead of read as a range
Label files: a number that is NaN or infinite makes the file damaged; in loose flags a word that says no is false, other words true
Serial labels: rows whose codes cannot be made are named before printing

When the printer cannot tell how many labels of a job printed (a lost connection), the message says how many printed for certain and how many may have; printing again from the row it names may print some twice but leaves none out

Fixes: XLSX number formats, embedded images and PDF pages up to 100 MB, labels rendered again for another resolution on cab and NIIMBOT printers, DYMO LabelWriter 4XL found by its IP address, IPP documents on slow connections

description.p: Bug fixes.

ul.li: Print server: other labels loaded than the label's (another size or label distance) are pointed out in the preview, the print request and the job, as in the window and on the command line; the label prints anyway
Print server: a printer's status tells the print method and label sensing the server's jobs use, beside the ones set on the printer
The command line also points out Brother QL DK labels of another size

A Brother QL with die-cut labels is now asked before printing, on the command line and in print server jobs, and its answer counts for the cut, mode and quality chosen; on the command line and in print server jobs without a printer list an unreachable printer waits up to 15 s before the print fails, and a dry run with an address contacts the printer (--no-query avoids it)
A damaged spreadsheet compressed with Zstandard gives the message about the data file instead of a general error

description.p: Bug fixes.

ul.li: Zebra (ZPL) printers report the loaded labels: a label distance other than the label's is pointed out before printing
A text too long (one line) or too tall (many lines) to be drawn now says so, instead of a general error
Print server: Arial, Calibri and other office fonts drawn by their metric-compatible stand-ins no longer count as missing
Print server: the document pages of one label share a time limit and are drawn once for a whole series, and per-printer memory is bounded
Setting a placeholder such as {Inventory} on the command line or through the print server says that it is a data column and how to send it

description.p: Many more printers, and much more to design.

ul.li: Office printers through CUPS or IPP (PDF, PWG Raster, Apple Raster): one label per page or on over 1700 label sheets
Printers on USB as well as on the network
New printers: Brother QL, Brother P-touch, cab EOS, SQUIX and MACH, NIIMBOT, and printers with ZPL, EPL2, TSPL, ESC/POS or DYMO LabelWriter
Serial labels from CSV, ODS or XLSX files; variables for date, time, counter, copy number and random IDs
Shipping labels from a carrier's PDF or image

Data Matrix, PDF417, Aztec, Code 39, Code 93, EAN-8, UPC, ITF-14 and GS1 codes (Zint); QR codes with a chosen error correction; every module a whole number of printer dots, with a warning for bars thinner than 0.17 mm or 2 printer dots
Over 7000 symbols from Material Design Icons; lines and shapes
Free layout: each element at its own position
Design options for text, images and borders, font weights, undo and redo
Black-and-white printers: sharp text and codes, a warning when an element does not stand out from the background
cab: print method per printer (thermal transfer or direct), print upside down, a hint when the loaded labels have another spacing
Command line: data files, variables, --print-method, and with --dry-run --output a PNG of each label
Print server: REST API and MCP, named printers with their settings in printers.toml, named tokens with roles, a systemd unit and a Docker Compose example
A new icon: a small slate tablet with a label, drawn for small sizes too
The window shows the Tavletta icon in title bars that display one
Also found when searching for ColAura or VC-500WCR, other names of the VC-500W

description.p: Packaging update, no changes to the app itself.

ul.li: Installing with pip now also installs the desktop entry, icons, MIME type, metainfo and translations
A broken translation stops the build instead of being skipped

description.p: First release.

ul.li: Design labels with text, images, QR codes and barcodes; automatic or fixed length
Finds the printer on the network and shows the inserted cassette, remaining tape and firmware
Exact print geometry with edge-to-edge backgrounds and a safety margin per printer
Vivid, standard and black-and-white modes, colour adjustment, full, half or no cut
Clear error messages, cassette age hint, report a problem from the app
Available in 27 languages
